title: Role of Eicosapentaenoic Acid (EPA) and Docosahexaenoic Acid (DHA) on Inflammation and Lipids

sections.abstract:
The objective of this study is to provide critical information regarding both common and distinctive roles of EPA and DHA in systemic inflammation and lipid metabolism.

Posted outcomes: Interleukin-6 (IL-6). timeframe=10 weeks. Placebo=0.96 (±0.56); EPA Intervention=1.01 (±0.51); DHA Intervention=0.99 (±0.77). p=0.33
